participation.context: Wrote the three lines and left the letter where it was.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Is still the person the leaf addresses, and is not in the room.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You put the forty sail at the foot of Sunday's letter and did not give the leaf to anyone. You did not replace forty with another count.

title: Added the forty sail to Sunday's letter

participation.context: Wrote the line and did not add a figure.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down the one line about distance and sureness, and you left the fleet uncounted.

title: Wrote that gold is surer the further it is
